title: Prairie Ridge Licensed Facilities: Posted Grade, Shrink and Freight Schedule for Grain Marketing Contracts
content:
This is the posted schedule of grade bases, shrink factors, discounts and the freight differential applying to grain taken in at the cooperative's licensed facilities under Grain Marketing Contracts. It carries the same figures on every marketing programme.

## Moisture and shrink

Bushels above the moisture base shrink by 1.18 percent of gross bushels for each moisture point above that base, whole and part points alike. The moisture base for yellow corn is 15.0 percent. The bases posted for the other commodities taken in are:

| Commodity | Moisture base (percent) | Test weight base (pounds per bushel) |
|---|---|---|
| Yellow corn | 15.0 | 54.0 |
| Soybeans | 13.0 | 54.0 |
| Hard red winter wheat | 13.5 | 58.0 |
| Oats | 14.0 | 32.0 |
| Grain sorghum | 14.0 | 56.0 |

## Posted discounts

| Discount | Basis | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Test weight | each whole pound below the base for the commodity | 0.02 USD per bushel |
| Foreign material | each percentage point above the free tolerance of 1.0 percent | 0.015 USD per bushel |
| Damage | the band the reading falls in, taking the rate of the lowest band whose ceiling the reading does not exceed | the damage bands set out below |

| Damage band ceiling (percent) | Discount (USD per bushel) |
|---|---|
| 5.0 | 0.000 |
| 10.0 | 0.030 |
| 15.0 | 0.075 |
| 20.0 | 0.140 |

A load whose damage reading reaches 20.0 percent is refused at the pit.

## Freight

Where a load is delivered to a facility other than the one the contract calls for, the posted freight differential is 0.045 USD per bushel, in the member's favour where the alternative facility is nearer the market and against them where it is further.
